name: mandate
description: Mandate - AI-native grocery commerce system (Phase 0 foundation)

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @mandate/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @mandate/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @mandate/types && npm run build -w @mandate/config
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @mandate/api && npm run build -w @mandate/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.supabase:seed: echo Seed file supabase/seed.sql is applied by supabase db reset locally only
